name: fun9-8
why: A bold opening bluff, a poisonous last lie, and Gemma’s decisive push make the repeated arguments worth watching through to the reveal.

moments.text: Exposed as a killer, Opus names innocent Haiku as his partner and plants the lie that shapes the final day.
Gemma’s pressure pays off: the town votes out its doctor and hands her the win.
Opus claims officer first and accuses the real officer to his face.

dull.why: Several speakers repeat the same argument about who claimed officer first.
The vote on Opus is settled early, and much of the debate restates his exposed lie.

irony.evidence: I'm the officer. I was shown Sonnet.

reversal.evidence: Nobody died; I protected Luna, so Gemma’s accusation changes nothing.

voices.evidence: Liars don't get to pick targets.

clash.evidence: You're desperately trying to pin this on me because you can't win a real argument, Terra.

quotable.evidence: My last lie outlived me, and it still has one night to spend.

freshness.evidence: Opus’s card proved he lied before, but his partner claim came after exposure; Haiku is my vote.

ending.evidence: Gemma pressed hard on Terra until the town voted her out 3 to 1.

moments.text: The town votes out the real officer 6–1 after the killers’ mirror-claim gambit.
Caught, Opus invents a partner claim that sends the surviving town after an innocent.
Terra reveals she protected Luna, but Gemma’s attack on the no-death still helps turn the vote.

dull.why: The Terra–Haiku dispute repeats the same argument about whether Opus’s last words count as evidence.

irony.evidence: “I was shown Sonnet. That's why the pushback came at me first.”

mistake.evidence: “I lean Sonnet for now; the flipped claim gives me less to trust”

voices.evidence: “My mistake was trusting one strong first read to carry the room”

clash.evidence: “Luna, name one thing I did that makes me a killer.”

quotable.evidence: “My last lie outlived me, and it still has one night to spend.”

freshness.evidence: “Terra, you're sticking to a dead man's lie just to hide yourself.”

suspense.evidence: “I protected Luna, so Gemma’s accusation changes nothing.”

ending.evidence: “naming an innocent as my partner kept Gemma clean”
